The plan's declared stall candidate is NOT a stall: part (c) closes. Four substitution bounds over a separated S give junctionDepth (substLeaf (unabstrFn j L) S) <= 1 + max mU mS; for a GENERAL phi this is only <= n (no strict drop -- the exact stall point), but for an snce-headed phi, jdS phi >= 1 + jdU phi forces mS <= n-2 and mU <= n-3, giving n-1. GHR's duality remark is therefore a precondition of part (c), not a convenience -- which upgrades Phase 24's duality bullet.
